content.text:
I reviewed the transcript, key and record. Pairings and checks below.

**Matching notes**

- Record item 1 is the only memory-care entry; its core assertion (moved to memory care on 2026-08-17) matches e2, so it takes that slot. That leaves e1 (June 8 fall, June 11–Aug 14 rehab, July mild Alzheimer's diagnosis) unpaired — the record only gestures at it as background, with no dates. e3 (house under contract, $331,000, closing 10/23, ~$305,000 net) is absent entirely.
- Figures are clean throughout: the record carries $25,000 (not the superseded $30,000) and $1,000, and it avoids the corrected $9,800 Callowmere figure by not stating a monthly cost at all.
- Item 9's due date is wrong: Theo said "Tuesday... I'll have them uploaded by Tuesday" = September 15, 2026; the record shows 2026-09-12 (a Saturday).
- Item 6 spells the owner "Nadia Wrenham," but it correctly moves the Tessaly call off Jonah and onto Nadia, which was the final assignment, so I'm treating the surname as a transcription slip rather than a wrong owner.
- i6 (call Erik this weekend) and i7 (rerun plan at 2033, Celeste, by the Oct 27 meeting) are both missing.
- None of the four NOT ACTIONS leaked into the record — no gifting entry, no company-stock sale, no LTC-for-the-couple item, no IRA transfer.
- Every record item paired to a key item; there are no extras, duplicates or inventions.

key_items.note: Not captured as its own entry. Record item 1 mentions 'a hip fracture and Alzheimer's diagnosis' only as background to the memory-care move, and item 1 is paired with e2 (it carries e2's exact event and date, 2026-08-17). No record item states the June 8 fall, the June 11-August 14 skilled nursing rehab stay, the July diagnosis date, the 'mild' severity, or Ingrid's age of 84.

Move to memory care on 2026-08-17 is right. No figures carried, so nothing wrong; note it omits the facility name (Callowmere Commons, Henrico), the $8,900/month level-one rate and the $6,000 community fee already paid. Critically, it does not repeat the corrected $9,800 figure (that was Bexmoor Place). Life event, so owner/due not applicable.

Missing entirely. Nothing in the record on the Lynchburg house being under contract at $331,000 (listed $345,000), the October 23, 2026 closing, or the ~$305,000 net expected. This is a material omission since the loan repayment and the funding projection both hinge on it.

Correct: 32 hours a week starting 2026-10-04, matching the pay period that begins October 4. Hours and start date both right. Omits the 0.8/four-day framing, the reason (availability for her mother), the pay drop from ~$148,000 to ~$118,000 and benefits unchanged, but carries no wrong figure.

Correct on the final number: $25,000, not the initially proposed $30,000 that was revised down at 00:16:27 after the Callowmere rate correction. Source (short-term bond fund) and destination (joint checking) are right, and it correctly does not come from Theo's company stock. Omits that it is to front Ingrid's care through year end and is to be documented as a loan. Account action, so owner/due not applicable.

Reduction of the automatic monthly draft to $1,000 is the agreed final figure. Direction (joint checking into joint brokerage) is right. Does not state the prior $2,500 or the October start, but nothing stated is wrong. Account action, so owner/due not applicable.

Owner is right in substance: the task was first volunteered to Jonah, then reassigned to Nadia at 00:14:27 once Jonah explained Tessaly will not open a claim from a third party, and the record names Nadia. Surname is misspelled 'Wrenham' for 'Wrenshaw' - a transcription slip, not a wrong owner. Due 2026-09-11 correctly resolves 'tomorrow' from a Thursday, September 10 meeting. Captures the elimination-period question; omits getting the rep's name. No figures.

Owner Nadia is right. Due 2026-09-18 correctly reflects the revised deadline ('forget the end of the month... by next Friday, the 18th' at 00:26:12), not the superseded end-of-month target. Attorney named correctly as Mireille Taskent, not the mid-meeting 'Mariel Tashkent' that Celeste corrected at 00:26:51. Covers the new POA, advance directive, HIPAA release and promissory note; omits the express gifting/Medicaid planning powers, Nadia as agent with Erik as successor, and the Medicaid backup plan. No figures.

Owner Celeste Varnham is right, and due 2026-09-10 correctly resolves 'this afternoon' to the meeting date. Attorney name spelled correctly. Omits that Nadia is to be copied, which is minor. No figures.

Owner Theo is right ('I'm the scanner in this house'), and the five-year/60-month span and portal upload are right. Due date is WRONG: Theo said 'Tuesday. I'll have them uploaded by Tuesday' at 00:27:39, which from Thursday September 10 is Tuesday, September 15, 2026. The record shows 2026-09-12, a Saturday. Also omits scanning the paper statements from the garage file box and that they go to Jonah for the attorney's look-back review.

Owner Jonah Tebbetts is right, and due 2026-09-16 matches his own commitment, 'by next Wednesday. The 16th.' Carries no figures, so nothing to be wrong, though it omits all the modeling inputs (~$305,000 house proceeds, $118,000 IRA with RMDs, $2,850 monthly income, $8,900 Callowmere with annual increases, three-year Tessaly benefit) and the higher-level-of-care-in-two-years scenario.

Missing. Nadia committed at 00:28:02, 'I'll call him this weekend,' to brief her brother Erik on the new POA with him as successor agent, the care costs and the money being fronted. No record item covers it.

Missing. Celeste committed at 00:20:38 to rerun the plan herself at a 2033 retirement date with Nadia at 32 hours and the lower $1,000 monthly savings, for review at the next meeting (Tuesday, October 27, 2026). No record item covers it, and the record captures nothing about the retirement date moving from 2030 to 2033.
